summary: Verified P1 Edit-Job flow (backend + frontend) and the new Reports screen. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (7 new edit/reports tests + 6 photo + 7 base repair-shop). POST /api/jobs/update now accepts all editable fields (name, phone, model, work, cost, amount, percentage, photo); server recomputes Profit=amount-cost and Share=Profit*pct/100 whenever any numeric field is patched; returns {ok:true, id, updated:[...]} listing the server-side keys changed (incl. recomputed Profit/Share). Non-existent id returns 404 {detail:'Job not found'}. Regression: {id,status:'Completed'} still marks completed with IST completed_date/completed_time auto-stamped. No-op patch with only {id} returns {ok:true, unchanged:true}. Editing a completed job preserves Status, received_*, and completed_* timestamps. GET /api/jobs still returns exactly 16 normalized keys. Frontend (mobile 390x844): pencil button renders on each card (btn-edit-<ID>); dialog opens pre-filled with Name/Phone/Model/Cost/Amount and correct repair-type chips parsed from Work (Screen+Battery active on seeded job). Changing Amount from 2000→3500 saves and card refreshes within ~2s to show Amount ₹3,500, Profit ₹3,000, Share ₹900. view-jobs/view-reports switch works. Reports screen renders period-today/week/month/all chips, report-revenue/cost/profit/share/jobs/status KPI grid, and recent-list. Switching periods re-aggregates correctly (Today == All since all seeded jobs are IST-today).

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge still overlaps bottom-right of the lowest job card and FAB area (pre-existing, documented in iteration 2). Consider raising FAB/CTA bottom margin above the badge.
Period range header reads 'From YYYY-MM-DD → today' for all non-'all' periods; for 'today' showing just the date would be clearer. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_job(): when SHEET_URL is set, we call sheet_get() to locate the existing record — this is an extra upstream round-trip per update. If/when Sheet mode is enabled, consider caching or changing Apps Script to return the current row on update to avoid double-fetch.

server.py update_job(): 'numeric_changed' block always sets Cost/Amount/Percentage in the updates payload even if only one numeric field was patched. Harmless for MongoDB, but on Sheet mode it writes unchanged columns back unnecessarily.

Reports.jsx inRange() uses string comparison on received_date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). This is correct only while stamps are IST strings; if a row ever has an empty received_date (legacy) it is excluded from 'All Time' via the implicit && rd check — but ternary in fromISO makes 'all' return '' so all rows pass. OK, but add a unit note: 'all' keeps rows even without received_date while 'today/week/month' silently drop them.

RepairShop.jsx: syncAfterWrite has a hard-coded 1000ms delay. Fine for MongoDB local mode; for Sheet mode there can be eventual-consistency >1s. Consider polling until the updated record is visible (max 3 tries) instead of a fixed sleep.

JobDialog.jsx parseWork() only matches exact REPAIR_TYPES strings; if user ever changes the chip labels (e.g., capitalization or a typo in storage), chips won't pre-select and everything falls into description. Consider case-insensitive match plus trimming.

JobDialog.jsx does not disable the Save button while the form is in a pristine state on edit; this is fine UX-wise but an unchanged save still hits POST /api/jobs/update (returns unchanged:true). Minor network noise — skip call if no diff vs job prop.

Reports.jsx: 'My Share' KPI sums Share for all jobs in the period including Pending ones. If the product intent is realised income, switch to Completed-only for Profit/Share. Flag to main agent — business decision.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed jobs in MongoDB during pytest (edit/numeric/complete/unchanged suites) + one TEST_UIEdit job seeded via the UI test to exercise the edit flow. Safe to drop test_database.jobs and anything with Name starting with 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit endpoint is unified at POST /api/jobs/update: {id, ...anyFields}. Status-only call still works (Mark Completed). Profit/Share are recomputed only when cost/amount/percentage is present in the patch. Frontend edit pencil = btn-edit-<ID>; dialog testid = job-dialog; period chips = period-today/week/month/all; KPIs = report-revenue/cost/profit/share/jobs/status; recent list = recent-list with per-row testid recent-<ID>. Sheet URL still empty → MongoDB fallback expected. Use /app/backend/tests/test_edit_and_reports.py as regression for this iteration.
rca of the issue: No defects found for Edit flow or Reports view.
